name: Maritime Greenwich
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: On the south bank of the Thames in east London, Maritime Greenwich gathers elegant 17th-century buildings around a royal park. You can see Inigo Jones's Queen's House, England's first Palladian building, and Christopher Wren's grand riverside naval college. Up the hill, the Old Royal Observatory marks the Greenwich Meridian, where east meets west at 0° longitude.
